utils/imageInserter.js.purpose: Read mixed image replies, place unmatched tags at the end of the story and retain editable drafts for the active message and swipe.

utils/promptReq.js.purpose: Use the parsed counts for final notifications; retain incomplete replies without retrying whole groups.

utils/iframe/placeholder.js.purpose: Restore footer buttons at the current end of the story in their original order.

index.js.purpose: Register draft restoration when the active chat or swipe changes.
